purpose: First standard aggregate polling update; community experiments are not a dependency
protected_evaluation_labels: No 2022 or 2024 labels; no CES political payload

covariance_model.movement_time_units: days to election / 30; covariance uses min(time_i,time_j)
covariance_model.regularizer: Independent Gaussian on log standard deviations; penalized likelihood/MAP in these coordinates
covariance_model.parameter_uncertainty: Conditional fitted scales, not integrated. Report frozen all-scale sensitivity multipliers.
covariance_model.sampling_variance: Included in historical total noise; no separate binomial, MOE, effective-N or design-effect term
covariance_model.universe_bridge: Zero expected difference from historical mixed-universe poll population; total error covers an exchangeability approximation, not a fitted RV/LV/adult conversion
covariance_model.house_transport: Zero mean in a new cycle; no fitted directional historical house mean transferred
covariance_model.historical_dependence: Fitted poll scales and saved fundamentals use common historical outcomes. Their parameter dependence is not integrated in this empirical-Bayes first pass.

selection.historical_training: One latest observation per cycle/race/pollster/fixed 14-day lead bin. Deterministic tie break by observation ID. Original fields retained. Unknown overlap remains a limitation.
selection.current: Only source-audited selected question, exact candidate-ID match, publication and field-end dates within cutoff. Latest sample per race/pollster. One question per underlying sample.
selection.historical_candidate_join: Unique eligible D/R state-cycle roster; not original candidate-name verified
selection.historical_availability: Field-end proxy. Future benchmark must include release-lag sensitivity; retrospective development only.
selection.special_rules: Preserve existing principal-contender proxies; AK explicit final RCV preferred; no first-round and final-round double counting
selection.unpolled: Unobserved race retains baseline residual law but shares the polling-updated cycle and historical parameter distribution

numerical_reporting_gates.failed_gate_action: Preserve attempt and extend or repair computation; no substantive tuning to forecast results

historical_benchmark_followup.status: Must freeze runner details, scoring implementation and adoption tolerances before scoring these folds. Initial all-cycle 2026 nuisance fit is not a holdout result.

claims.initial_rerun: A computational forecast comparison; no demonstrated forecast improvement
claims.community_identification: Not estimated in this baseline; no causal subgroup or composition attribution from toplines
claims.current_scope: Audited source subset with visible uncovered races, not an exhaustive polling census
claims.public_comparators: Descriptive only; no tuning to public win probabilities
